title: Kings of the South and North

questions.question: How many more kings were to arise in Persia?
questions.explanation: Daniel 11:2 (ESV): "Behold, three more kings shall arise in Persia,"

questions.question: The fourth king shall be far richer than all the others and shall stir up all against the kingdom of whom?
questions.explanation: Daniel 11:2 (ESV): "he shall stir up all against the kingdom of Greece."

questions.question: A mighty king shall arise and do what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 11:3 (ESV): "Then a mighty king shall arise, who shall rule with great dominion and do as he wills."

questions.question: Who shall be strong, but one of his princes shall be stronger than he?
questions.explanation: Daniel 11:5 (ESV): "Then the king of the south shall be strong, but one of his princes shall be stronger than he"

questions.question: The king of the north shall return and come into the what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 11:41 (ESV): "He shall come into the glorious land. And tens of thousands shall fall,"

questions.question: In the place of the king of the north shall arise a contemptible person to whom royal majesty has not been given. How shall he come in?
options: Without warning and obtain the kingdom by flatteries
questions.correctAnswer: Without warning and obtain the kingdom by flatteries
questions.explanation: Daniel 11:21 (ESV): "he shall come in without warning and obtain the kingdom by flatteries."

questions.question: Forces from him shall appear and profane the temple and fortress, and shall take away the regular burnt offering. And they shall set up what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 11:31 (ESV): "And they shall set up the abomination that makes desolate."

questions.question: The people who know their God shall stand firm and do what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 11:32 (ESV): "but the people who know their God shall stand firm and take action."

questions.question: The king shall exalt himself and magnify himself above every what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 11:36 (ESV): "He shall exalt himself and magnify himself above every god,"

questions.question: He shall honor the god of fortresses instead of whom?
questions.explanation: Daniel 11:38 (ESV): "He shall honor the god of fortresses instead of these."

questions.question: At the time of the end, the king of the south shall attack him, but the king of the north shall rush upon him like a what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 11:40 (ESV): "but the king of the north shall rush upon him like a whirlwind,"

questions.question: He shall pitch his palatial tents between the sea and the what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 11:45 (ESV): "And he shall pitch his palatial tents between the sea and the glorious holy mountain."

questions.question: Who shall escape out of his hand?
options: Edom and Moab and the main part of the Ammonites
questions.correctAnswer: Edom and Moab and the main part of the Ammonites
questions.explanation: Daniel 11:41 (ESV): "but these shall be delivered out of his hand: Edom and Moab and the main part of the Ammonites."

questions.question: What reports shall alarm him?
options: News from the east and the north
questions.correctAnswer: News from the east and the north
questions.explanation: Daniel 11:44 (ESV): "But news from the east and the north shall alarm him,"

questions.question: Yet he shall come to his end, with none to do what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 11:45 (ESV): "Yet he shall come to his end, with none to help him."

key_verse_text: He shall seduce with flattery those who violate the covenant, but the people who know their God shall stand firm and take action.
